name: Paradigm of Greed
description: You can form lifelong [effect:contract][dark-gray]contracts[/dark-gray][/effect] with humanoids by gifting them 5 raw gold, [dark-red]but[/dark-red] if ever you don’t re-up their contract, they [effect:betray][dark-gray]betray[/dark-gray][/effect] you.

effects.explanation:
You can have 4 contractors, who each gain vanishing, unbreakable, golden copies of your armor, reset to their standard max health, and unshakably follow you between worlds.

New contracts last 1 hour, and can be extended by 20 minutes per additional raw gold given to them.
Betraying contractors forcibly target you, gain attack damage, speed, and knockback resistance, and their contract cannot be resumed.
